\begin{quote}\small
  \textbf{build up comparison before and after my patches.}
  The Catalyst project uses PyPSA-Earth to simulate current and future power systems of more than 100 countries, or more than 99.5\% of global power demand.
  It also enhances PyPSA-Earth to capture how investment into 100\% clean power supply now, affects long-term technology prices and thereby the costs of a carbon-free power system.\\
  This is a full documentation of the methodology employed, covering the composition of the present system, its validation, techno-ecnonomic assumptions, the step-wise approach to modelling future energy systems in five-year-intervals and finally the learning heueristic applied.
\end{quote}
